name: user-message-commits
surface: crates/operant-cli/src/tui/adapter_types/tui_app.rs (all three submit paths) + app/tui_state_impl.rs display cache
opens_with: Fresh boot; the user sends a message and the turn is still pending - no agent event has arrived yet
keys: Commit this line before any reply<enter>
assert_screen: contains:Commit this line before any reply
notes: The 2026-10-09 live audit N-2 gate: every submit path pushed the user Message without bumping transcript_version, so the display cache (keyed on that version) stayed stale-empty until the first agent event - the sent message was invisible in the transcript, the decorative idle orb kept painting over it (has_started_conversation reads the same stale cache), and a scrolled view rendered blank. The empty agent script means NO event ever bumps the version: the only way the message can render is the submit path's own invalidate. The composer clears on submit, so the contains-assert can only pass through the transcript. Reproduced first-hand on the deployed binary (PageUp after a submit blanked the view; a fresh-cache session did not).
